strategist.subject: dpdp_india
strategist.claim: Personal data of users in India puts the product under the DPDP Act.

strategist.subject: azure_waf
strategist.claim: The company already runs on Azure, so its Well-Architected Framework is the baseline.
strategist.benefit: Reviews use the provider's own checklists.

strategist.subject: twelve_factor
strategist.claim: Containers and CI/CD are already in place, which Twelve-Factor assumes.

strategist.subject: evolutionary_architecture
strategist.claim: Start as one deployable and extract parts only when a real need appears.
strategist.benefit: Less to operate at 150 daily users.

rejected_alternative.name: microservices_first
rejected_alternative.reason: A team of five cannot run many services.

strategist.subject: event_driven
strategist.claim: Video rendering is long-running, so it runs as background jobs on a queue.
strategist.benefit: Users are not blocked while media renders.
strategist.cost: A queue to run and monitor.
strategist.condition: Limit events to the media pipeline; keep the rest request-response.

strategist.subject: c4_model
strategist.claim: C4 diagrams give the reviewers one shared picture of the system.

strategist.subject: adr
strategist.claim: Each council decision is recorded as an ADR.

strategist.subject: atam
strategist.claim: A full ATAM workshop is too heavy for a three-month pilot.

rejected_alternative.name: lightweight risk review
rejected_alternative.reason: Gives most of the value in an hour.

strategist.subject: build_approach
strategist.claim: Assemble from Azure managed AI services, the company's existing cloud.
strategist.benefit: Data stays in India on a platform the team knows.
strategist.condition: Production use waits until each service passes the production gate.

rejected_alternative.name: self-host open-source models
rejected_alternative.reason: A team of five should not run GPU servers.

strategist.subject: delivery_path
strategist.claim: Design the production target first; the POC is its first slice: one document to summary and audio.

architect.subject: dpdp_india
architect.claim: Personal data must be mapped through every flow, including generated media.

architect.subject: azure_waf
architect.claim: Azure is the existing platform; its reliability and security pillars fit.
architect.cost: Some pillars are heavy for a pilot.

architect.subject: twelve_factor
architect.benefit: Clean separation of config and code.

architect.subject: evolutionary_architecture
architect.claim: A modular monolith with a separate media worker fits the scale.

rejected_alternative.name: microservices_first
rejected_alternative.reason: A team of five cannot run many services.

architect.subject: event_driven
architect.claim: Rendering jobs and notifications are naturally event-driven.

architect.subject: c4_model
architect.claim: Context and container diagrams are enough at this size.

architect.subject: adr
architect.claim: ADRs keep the reasons behind each choice.

architect.subject: atam
architect.claim: Run a short ATAM-style session on latency and cost only.
architect.benefit: Explicit trade-offs on the two risks that matter.

platform_cost.subject: dpdp_india
platform_cost.claim: Residency in India limits which regions and services can be used.

platform_cost.subject: azure_waf
platform_cost.claim: Its cost-optimisation pillar keeps spend inside the monthly budget.

platform_cost.subject: twelve_factor
platform_cost.claim: Stateless services scale down to cut idle cost.

platform_cost.subject: evolutionary_architecture
platform_cost.claim: One deployable is the cheapest thing to run for 150 users.

rejected_alternative.name: microservices_first
rejected_alternative.reason: A team of five cannot run many services.

platform_cost.subject: event_driven
platform_cost.claim: A managed queue is cheap; a self-run broker is not.
platform_cost.condition: Use a managed queue, not a self-hosted broker.

platform_cost.subject: c4_model
platform_cost.claim: Diagrams cost almost nothing to keep.

platform_cost.subject: adr
platform_cost.claim: ADRs record why each paid service was chosen.

platform_cost.subject: atam
platform_cost.claim: A workshop costs more than this pilot's risks justify.

critic.subject: dpdp_india
critic.claim: The DPDP rules on AI-generated content are not settled yet.
critic.condition: Re-check when DPDP rules are notified.

critic.subject: azure_waf
critic.claim: Following Azure's framework is safe, but it must not become a reason to skip simpler options.

critic.subject: evolutionary_architecture
critic.claim: Video rendering may need to scale apart from the rest, which this fact sheet only assumes.
critic.cost: A wrong assumption means early extraction.
critic.condition: Revisit if rendering queues back up in the pilot.

critic.subject: event_driven
critic.claim: Events everywhere add tracing cost the team does not need; a simple job queue is enough.
critic.cost: None, if only the queue is used.

critic.subject: atam
critic.claim: Without a structured review, the AI quality risk goes unexamined.
